text: Last summer, I finally travelled abroad for the first time. Planning the trip took weeks, but choosing the destination was easy. I wanted to experience a completely new culture. When I arrived, everything felt exciting but also a little confusing. The food was amazing, though I sometimes didn't know what I was ordering. Language barriers were the biggest challenge. Simple things like asking for directions often turned into funny games of gestures. Despite these difficulties, I learned so much about the world and myself. Now, whenever I look at my photos, those memories make me smile and want to travel again.
